questions.q: Core: (a) Evaluate 125^(−2/3) (b) Simplify (3a⁴b)³ (c) Work out (4.2 × 10⁵) + (3 × 10⁴) in standard form (d) Simplify √(9x⁸)
Extend : The mass of a hydrogen atom is 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg. How many hydrogen atoms are in 1 kg? Give your answer in standard form to 3 s.f.
Stretch : 2ᵃ × 4ᵇ = 64 and 3ᵃ ÷ 9ᵇ = 1. Find a and b.
questions.a: a + 2b = 6 and a − 2b = 0, so a = 3, b = 1.5
